subject: Computer Science
instructions:
API design document for a campus library service.
Your document must specify:
- The list of endpoints with their HTTP methods
- The authentication method
- The error response format
- A rate limiting policy
- How the API will be versioned
draft:
Endpoints: GET /v1/books searches the catalog, GET /v1/books/{id} returns one book, POST /v1/loans checks a book out, and DELETE /v1/loans/{id} returns it.
Every request must send a JSON Web Token in the Authorization header, issued by the campus single sign-on service.
The version is part of the URL path. When we make a breaking change we will publish /v2 and keep /v1 running for one year so existing clients keep working.
notes: Error format and rate limiting absent. Versioning is covered in different words.
